data.title: Damac Towers
data.about:
Welcome to Damac Towers by Paramount Hotels & Resorts Dubai.  Comprising 4 towers, wherein, the 3 towers are home to about 1200 luxury serviced suites while the fourth one is the first Paramount Hotel and Paramount Residences in the world.

Each of the four towers stretches over 250 meters in height, joined by a multi-level plaza. Residents and guests can enjoy high-end shopping with the perfect combination of global luxury and California cool, implemented through a signature Paramount Hotels & Resorts merchandise store: The Vault. As a resident of Damac Tower by Paramount Hotels & Resorts, you’ll experience the height of fashionable living with the service standards of the finest luxury hotels; and when you’re away, you’ll earn impressive rental income from your exquisite property.

DAMAC Towers by Paramount Hotels & Resorts is nestled in Dubai’s Burj area. Close to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, Damac Towers is located close to the Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International airport. This is a perfect investment opportunity for you to own a property in this first-of-its-kind project by Damac and Paramount Hotels and Resorts.
